verdict.rationale: Aider works directly in your local git repo. Every AI edit is committed to standard git history with descriptive messages and '(aider)' author metadata. Configuration lives in a plain `.aider.conf.yml` file or `AIDER_xxx` environment variables, so your work already sits in open formats and leaving takes no export step. Missing for 10: any documentation of how chat history or session data is stored and whether it can be exported, an explicit data-portability or no-lock-in statement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
